_format: entries newest first; every entry has a version. status "dev" = in development (at most one, first); no status = released. date: "YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM" locally, published as "YYYY-MM-DD". item type: new | improve | fix. zh/en text; `backticks` become <code>.

items.zh: 详情、设置面板、轮盘齿轮打开的配置界面，以及工具栏菜单（光照、角色状态、手持物品、贴图）、语言菜单和对话框都加入过冲效果：弹出时冲过头再回弹，关闭时先向反方向蓄力再收起。可在设置 → 外观 → “弹出窗口过冲”中关闭，并用“滑入过冲量”“滑出过冲量”两个滑条调节幅度。
items.en: The Details and Settings panels, the wheel gear's settings panel, toolbar menus (lighting, player status, held items, textures), the language menu and dialogs now overshoot: they pass their place slightly and settle back when opening, and pull back the other way before closing. Turn it off in Settings → Appearance → "Panel overshoot", and adjust the amount with the "Open overshoot" and "Close overshoot" sliders.

items.zh: 工具栏移到 3D 视图外的右下角，改为横向一排并去掉阴影，菜单从工具栏上方打开；3D 视图全屏时不显示工具栏。
items.en: The toolbar moved out of the 3D view to below its bottom-right corner, as a single row without a shadow; its menus open above it. It is not shown in the 3D view's fullscreen.

items.zh: F11 现在只进入/退出 3D 视图全屏，不再让整个软件窗口全屏；整个窗口全屏请用顶栏的全屏按钮。
items.en: F11 now enters and leaves fullscreen for the 3D view only, not the whole window; use the header's fullscreen button for the whole window.

items.zh: 删除设置“自动隐藏工具栏”：工具栏已移到 3D 视图外，不再挡住画面。
items.en: Removed the "Auto-hide toolbar" setting: the toolbar now sits outside the 3D view and no longer covers it.

items.zh: 3D 视图铺满窗口：去掉页面最大宽度并缩小四周留白，视图高度随窗口变化。
items.en: The 3D view now fills the window: no maximum page width, smaller margins, and its height follows the window.

items.zh: 设置 → 外观新增“3D 视图浮层无阴影”（默认开启）：3D 视图中的状态标签、菜单、面板、轮盘等弹出内容不再有阴影，改用更深的底色区分前景和背景。
items.en: New setting in Settings → Appearance, on by default: "Flat 3D view overlays". Status chips, menus, panels, the wheel and other pop-ups in the 3D view drop their shadows and stand out from the background with a deeper fill instead.

items.zh: 删除右上角的渲染模式切换：YSM 模型一律使用与游戏一致的原始面渲染，不再提供工程还原渲染。
items.en: Removed the render mode switch in the top-right corner: YSM models now always use raw-face rendering, which matches the game; the project-restore rendering is gone.

items.zh: 工具栏改用更深的底色；开启自动取色时显示与模型配色一致的渐变。
items.en: The toolbar has a deeper fill; with Auto color on it shows a gradient in the model's colors.

items.zh: 自动取色更贴近模型：不再把肤色计入取色（以前常被腮红、嘴唇的红色带偏成橙红），并改用模型主色调中最常见的颜色，而不是一小块最鲜艳的高光。
items.en: Auto color matches the model better: skin no longer counts (blush and lip reds used to turn many interfaces orange-red), and the seed is the most common color of the model's main hue instead of a small, very saturated highlight.

items.zh: 自动取色改用 Material 3 Expressive 的配色方案：菜单和面板饱和度更低；按钮、开关、滑条使用更浅的模型色并配深色文字。
items.en: Auto color now uses the Material 3 Expressive color scheme: menus and panels are less saturated, and buttons, switches and sliders use a lighter shade of the model color with dark text.

items.zh: 轮盘搜索定位时的扇区闪烁更明显：改为快速闪烁两下，颜色按自动取色的主色调整到与轮盘背景有足够对比度，文字同时切换为黑或白以保持清晰。
items.en: The sector flash when Wheel Search jumps to a result is now much easier to see: two quick blinks in the theme's primary colour, adjusted for enough contrast with the wheel, with the label switching to black or white so it stays readable.

items.zh: 新增轮盘搜索：在设置的“搜索”中打开后弹出一个独立窗口，按名称搜索轮盘里的动作、子分类和设置面板，并显示所在的轮盘路径和页码；点击结果会自动打开轮盘、翻到那一页并闪烁对应分区。窗口可调节透明度。
items.en: New Wheel Search: turn it on under Settings → Search to open a separate window that finds actions, sub-categories and settings panels in the action wheel by name, showing each one's wheel path and page. Clicking a result opens the wheel on that page and flashes the sector. The window's opacity is adjustable.

items.zh: 详情、预览、设置收进左侧“查看器”下面；打开软件直接显示预览，详情和设置改为居中弹出的面板（左上返回、右上关闭），打开时模型的动画和声音不再停止。
items.en: Details, Preview and Settings now sit under Viewer in the left rail; the app opens straight to the preview, and Details and Settings open as a centered panel (back at top left, close at top right) without stopping the model's animation or sound.

items.zh: 截图按钮移到右侧工具栏，去掉 3D 视图右下角挡住画面的截图面板和骨骼数显示。
items.en: The screenshot button moved into the right-hand toolbar; the panel in the bottom-right corner of the 3D view that covered the model, along with its bone count, is gone.
